publications.audience: the owner of a mechanical contracting business

issues.headline: The IRS confirmed on August 10 that employers must report FLSA overtime premiums in box 12 of the 2026 Form W-2 under a new code TT
issues.summary: The IRS made 2026 overtime a W-2 reporting problem, Commerce proposed tariffing heat exchanger parts and electric cable, an August 26 executive order shut foreign transformers and inverters out of the bulk power grid, solar modules got a $0.38-a-watt price floor, and June equipment shipments jumped — every claim sourced.

issues.headline: Section 232 tariffs cut residential HVAC duty to 15%, but commercial refrigeration, copper pipe and electrical wire still pay 25% as copper hit a record $6.71 a pound
issues.summary: Plumbing and HVAC/R distributors posted August 2026 price hikes from 3% to 25%, the EV charger tax credit expired June 30, lead-service-line replacement plans are due November 1, 2027, and Texas adopts the 2026 electrical code September 1 — every claim sourced.

publications.audience: the owner of a building, roofing or renovation business

issues.headline: New-home demand broke in July: housing starts fell 12.4 percent, new-home sales fell 10.5 percent, and unsold new houses reached 9.6 months of supply
issues.summary: July housing starts fell 12.4 percent and new-home sales 10.5 percent while construction input costs ran 7.1 percent above a year ago; Cal/OSHA split $282,420 across three roofers on one job site; the 2027 IECC went final; and the whole steel-framing shelf reprices September 1.

issues.headline: A 50% tariff on Canadian cement, plywood and furniture takes effect August 19 under a century-old trade law, even as softwood lumber duties keep falling
issues.summary: OSHA proposed a $172,324 roofing-fall fine, California's contractor workers'-comp fines doubled to $10,000-$20,000, Sherwin-Williams raised paint 9% and bulk solvent 18% on May 1, and impact windows now cost $1,200 to $2,250 more per project — every claim sourced.

publications.audience: the owner of a residential services business

issues.headline: Pending home sales fell 2.3% in July to 71.2, the lowest since January, and new single-family sales fell 10.5% to a 607,000 annual rate
issues.summary: Pending home sales fell to 71.2 and new single-family sales to a 607,000 annual rate, fewer than 3,000 H-2B numbers remain in the first-half FY2027 cap, DOE's commercial water heater standard binds October 6, and diesel hit $5.652 a gallon - every claim sourced.

issues.headline: BLS's July CPI shows motor fuel up 24.8% over the year while motor vehicle insurance fell 4.5%, its second straight monthly decline, released August 12, 2026
issues.summary: Water, sewer and trash prices rose 4.6% against 3.4% overall CPI, the H-2B supplemental window stays open until September 15, PoolCorp's Q2 sales hit $1.8 billion as margin slipped to 29.7%, and Commerce proposed 25% tariffs on cargo trailers — every claim sourced.

publications.audience: the owner of a commercial services or facilities business

issues.headline: A 50% additional duty on 554 lines of Canadian goods — cement, plastics, adhesives, machinery, electrical equipment and carpet among them — took effect August 22
issues.summary: A 50% Section 338 duty on 554 lines of Canadian goods took effect August 22, Missouri's asphalt index moved again to $631.25, diesel hit $5.652 a gallon, the SCA fringe rate rose to $5.92, and commercial property premiums fell 6.3% — every claim sourced.

issues.headline: Construction input prices were flat in July 2026 but 7.4% above a year ago, with steel mill products up 22.5% and diesel up over 50 cents a gallon
issues.summary: Missouri's posted asphalt price jumped 24.4% to $605.00 by June, the construction backlog indicator fell to 8.0 months, commercial property insurance fell 8.1% for a fifth straight quarter, and NFPA 72 cuts the alarm-impairment window from 24 hours to 8 — every claim sourced.

publications.audience: the owner of a professional services firm

issues.headline: The SBA proposed on August 20 to cut nearly 1,000 small-business size standards down to 338, making 114,541 more firms eligible for federal contracts and SBA loans
issues.summary: SBA would cut nearly 1,000 size standards to 338, DHS proposes a $103,265 H-1B fee, the EO 11246 contractor rules die October 26, FIRE shuts off November 19, and Do Not Call access hits $85 an area code.

issues.headline: FinCEN's August 14 final rule permanently ends federal beneficial-ownership reporting for domestic small businesses, exempting an estimated 32 million companies from Corporate Transparency Act filings
issues.summary: RentGrow will pay $2.25 million to settle FTC tenant-screening claims, the No Surprises Act arbitration fee drops from $115 to $15, the IRS mileage rate rises to 76 cents July 1, and the blocked $100,000 H-1B fee expires September 20 — every claim sourced.

publications.audience: the owner of an independent practice

issues.headline: Treasury made the Corporate Transparency Act exemption permanent on August 11 and the rule took effect August 14, ending beneficial ownership filing for U.S.-formed practices
issues.summary: Treasury made the Corporate Transparency Act exemption permanent August 14, ending beneficial ownership filing for U.S.-formed practices; small-group health premiums are filed up a median 14% for 2027; CDT 2027 changes 67 dental codes; South Carolina bars research-grade peptides; Medicaid renewals are backing up before work reporting starts.

issues.headline: CMS proposed cutting the Medicare conversion factor 1.68% to $32.84 for 2027, adding a richer visit-complexity modifier and new remote-monitoring staffing rules; comments close September 14
issues.summary: Dental staff costs are up 23% since 2021 while insurance reimbursement rose 21% and Medicaid 18%, Medicaid work requirements begin October 1, Indiana's first med-spa law requires registration by January 1, 2027, and HHS awarded $223.1 million in behavioral-health grants — every claim sourced.

issues.headline: Washington's insurance commissioner signed a claims-handling rule on Aug. 18 that from Oct. 18 gives insurers five business days to answer a shop's supplement in writing
issues.summary: Washington's claims-handling rule takes effect Oct. 18, Texas insurers must comply with mandatory appraisal from Sept. 1, and CPI shows vehicle repair prices up 6.6% while auto insurance prices fell 4.5% — every claim sourced.

issues.headline: TechForce's 2026 report finds U.S. auto-service, collision and diesel shops face a combined 43,135-technician annual shortfall, with collision hiring covering only 43 percent of need
issues.summary: Commerce set a final tire-tariff rate up to 78.33% on August 14, Illinois' right-to-appraisal law takes effect July 1, 2027, and Mister Car Wash went private at roughly $3.1 billion as ZIPS filed Chapter 11 with $653.9 million in debt — every claim sourced.
